prerequisites: Knowledge of CAD modeling is an advantage, but not necessary.

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to express oneself graphically - a basic means of communication for engineers.
Acquire knowledge and skills necessary for the following subjects ED2, ED3, ED4, MEM1, MEM2.
Breakdown of machine components into basic geometric shapes - component analysis.
Unify knowledge about creating drawing documentation (philosophy of displaying and dimensioning described within ISO GPS).
Display and dimensioning of geometrically different components - increasing complexity and monitoring the function of the component.

syllabus_topics: Subject introduction. Lectures and practises content. Standardisation of the technical documentation, lettering of drawings. Utilities for the practises and recommended literature. Internet information.

Technical drawings (types, scales, formats, type of lines, folding of drawings). Principles of the representation in technical drawings. Orthographic projection. Rules of representation - number and choice of views.
Using and drawing of sectional views and sections. Interruption of views. Representation of symmetrical parts. Special views, simplification of representation.
Principles of the dimensioning in technical drawings. Arrangement and systems of dimensioning. Dimensioning of the basic geometrical bodies.
Representation and dimensioning of the standard elements (recesses, centre holes, knurlings, threads, thread fasteners, their indication).
Accuracy of dimensions and its indication in the technical drawings. Indication of the surface texture (surface roughness) in the technical drawings.
Edge state introduction, accuracy, roughness. Representation and dimensioning of the compression spring
